sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
SINDH
BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(i) This Act, may be
called the Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Act, 1998.
(ii) It shall come into force
at once.

Definitions

SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
SINDH
BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
2. Amendment of section 19 of Sindh Ordinance No.V of 1979.‑In
the Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979, in section 19, in subsection (1‑A),
for the existing proviso, the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"Provided that no offence relating to buildings works commenced or
carried out in violation of the regulations framed or deemed to be framed
under section 21‑A, shall be compounded."

Repeal

SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
SINDH
BUILDINGS CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
3. Repeal of Sindh Ordinance No.XIII of 1997.‑‑The Sindh
Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance', 1997 is hereby repealed.
